title: Molecular mechanisms of ferroptosis in ulcerative colitis: insights from machine learning, WGCNA, and immune cell infiltration analysis.
summary: Full text identifies MFN2 and CBS via differential-expression screening, LASSO/SVM-RFE and WGCNA on UC cohorts; it tests expression against external GSE92415 and in Caco-2 inflammatory/ferroptosis experiments. The results support candidate ferroptosis-linked UC markers, with cell-model and retrospective-cohort limits.
